newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico jails two aides of top drug baron.
newsitem.headline: Mexico jails two aides of top drug baron.

text.p: Two deputies of one of Mexico's most powerful drug barons were jailed on Tuesday pending trial on charges of narcotics running, the Attorney General's Office said.
Jose Gerardo Hernandez Gutierrez, alias El Flaco, and Jefthe Avila Gaytan, alias El Jefthe, were sent to Mexico City's western jail to await trial.

Both are deputies of drug baron Amado Carrillo Fuentes, alias the Lord of Skies, a nickname gained for his brazen tactic of using commerical aircraft for ferrying drug loads destined for the United States from Colombia to Mexico.
The two aides were arrested May 2 in a Mexico City hotel bar after they planned the details of a cocaine shipment coming from Colombia, the Attorney General's Office said.
Carillo Fuentes' cartel controls the middle section of the U.S.-Mexico border and is described by the U.S. Drug Enforcement Administration (DEA) as "the most powerful man in the Mexican drug trade".
Carillo Fuentes has been a fugitive for eight years and is the subject of at least 26 separate DEA investigations.
